dataset: synthetic, deterministic (random.Random seed 11): 2600 embeddings of 768 dims (nomic-embed-text), 40 topic centers, noise 0.35; 2000 in the readable project (1979 current: 21 deleted), 600 in another project in the same index; 20 queries (seed-derived, noise 0.5)

decision.reason: spec defaults kept: recall@10 = 1.0 for ef_search 10..200 on this data, so no change is justified by evidence; ef_search 100 leaves headroom for the limit cap of 100

parameter_sweep_source: scratch run on an isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 + pgvector 0.8.7 (same dataset as test_vector_index: 2600 rows, 20 queries), ef_search patched via store_vectors.HNSW_EF_SEARCH; ms_per_query is wall time of search_vectors including connection and payload fetch, indicative only; 2026-11-09, run for the fix1 code

plan.summary: Limit > Incremental Sort > Index Scan using memory_embedding_hnsw_d8113c0d26a9b5c0 (Order By embedding::vector(768) <=> query); filters (project, current version, hash, norm) applied during the scan

retrieval_eval_gate.command: docker run --rm --network=none -e MEMORY_RETRIEVAL_EVAL=1 kairos-test:rq python -m memory_platform.tests.run_postgres
retrieval_eval_gate.note: dataset-v1 has 72 embeddable resources (52 memories + 20 documents); with such a population the planner and the exact fallback (population <= 10,000) decide the route, so the gate shows no regression of the mechanics; HNSW recall is evidenced by test_vector_index (2,600 rows), not by this gate; model quality is measured in T-36
retrieval_eval_gate.reason_exit_1: expected: the gate is red against the thresholds until phases 4-6 (fused recall@5 0.5 < 0.8, fused MRR 0.339809 < 0.6, subset gains 0)

sweep_note: recall@10 vs the exact cosine computed in Python over the same readable rows; ef_search varied by patching config constants in a scratch run; tag_rare = filter matching ~15 of 1979 readable rows (0.8 %) answered by iterative scan with 0 exact fallbacks
